description: Semantic search over one vendor's contract clauses. Ask a plain-language question (for example "what does the brake rate include and when is a change order needed") and get the clauses of that vendor's contracts that answer it best, with the item, rate in cents and the business-day validity window. Uses the JINA embedding of each clause (clause_semantic), so wording does not have to match. Use it when a rate or an invoice line needs the governing contract language, not just the number.

configuration.query: FROM contracts METADATA _score | WHERE vendor_id == ?vendor_id AND MATCH(clause_semantic, ?question) | SORT _score DESC | KEEP contract_id, item, rate_cents, valid_from, valid_to, clause, _score | LIMIT 3

vendor_id.description: Vendor id as a string, e.g. "3"

question.description: Plain-language question about the contract terms, e.g. "what does the brake rate include and when is a change order needed"
